wrong.why: Judah here is the kingdom over which Jehoiachin reigns, not the patriarch represented by the slug judah.

missing.why: Mattaniah is called Jehoiachin's father's brother, and verse 6 identifies Jehoiakim (eliakim-2) as Jehoiachin's father.

note: Verse 17 renames Mattaniah Zedekiah, so the relationships concerning Zedekiah in verse 18 correctly target mattaniah.
